A1.justification: Both PDFs describe LLMBRACES and provide readable main text, equations, Figures 1–2, Tables 1–11, and Appendices A–D. Matching relocated material establishes a reliable comparison without material gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original LLMBRACES results for reasoning, zero-shot generalization, sentiment steering, toxicity suppression, and relevance-module ablation in Tables 1–6, alongside qualitative examples.

after.justification: v2 retains these original LLMBRACES experiments and qualitative results. Attribution of some baseline scores to prior work does not change the originality of the proposed method's reported outcomes.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 retain the same low-rank relevance computation, additive gated FFN augmentation, and attribute-conditioned steering in Equations (3)–(7). No algorithm, objective, component, or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the eight commonsense tasks, Dolly-based instruction tuning, factual-knowledge and truthfulness evaluations, AGI Eval, sentiment steering, and toxicity suppression. StyleDataset and the conditional-generation training and evaluation datasets are unchanged.

E2.justification: LoRA comparisons in Tables 1–2 and the LoRA, DExperts, GeDi, LMSteer, and PromptT5 comparisons in Tables 3 and 5 retain identical comparator memberships. The GPT2-Large sentiment baseline is also retained.

E3.justification: The backbones, ranks, metrics, and experimental settings are unchanged. Both specify the 300-example tuning subset, three/six training epochs, and 5,000 sentiment or 10,000 toxicity prompts with 25 generations per prompt. Relocating Table 7 does not alter its settings.

E4.justification: Table 6 retains the same ablation replacing computed relevance scores with learned parameters, using the same configurations and results. Sentiment-intensity and toxicity-suppression examples in Tables 4 and 8 are unchanged; no additional robustness or supplementary analysis appears.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without independent-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The sampling of 25 generations per prompt is unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and qualitative outputs are unchanged. For example, both report a 37.25 zero-shot average for Llama3-8B LLMBRACES at rank 16 in Table 2 and a 0.027 zero-shot toxicity probability in Table 5.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(7) and the orthonormal-projection assumption retain the same mathematics. Section 4.1 corrects r_i,0 to r_i,j when describing the j-th component; this fixes an indexing typo consistent with the existing equations, without changing a definition, derivation, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: relevance-based FFN modulation, parameter-efficient improvements in supervised and zero-shot settings, and controlled generation. The claim of up to 75% fewer tunable parameters than LoRA is unchanged.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability boundaries are unchanged. Both acknowledge evaluation only on text-based LLMs and incomplete understanding of internal mechanisms. Completing the limitations phrase with 'architectures and domains' repairs its wording without adding a substantive qualification.

D1.justification: v2 removes the explicit Kaggle URL and hyperlink from the Jigsaw dataset reference, reducing direct access information. Optimizer settings, hyperparameters, epochs, hardware, evaluation details, and StyleDataset construction instructions in Appendices B–C remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, and positioning relative to model editing and controllable generation are unchanged. The Jigsaw dataset citation remains despite removal of its URL; no cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 corrects several local errors, including 'FNN', duplicated affiliation text, the relevance-component subscript, the redundant opening of Section 6.1, and an incomplete limitations sentence. It adds acknowledgements while retaining the overall narrative and section organization.

P2.justification: v2 enlarges Figure 2 and Table 5, adjusts spacing and some table widths, and moves Table 7 from PDF page 12 to page 13. All figures and tables are retained, with limited layout changes rather than a substantial redesign.

improvement.justification: Corrected wording and indexing modestly improve clarity, while the enlarged Figure 2 and Table 5 improve legibility. The scientific content and empirical support remain unchanged. Removing the direct Jigsaw dataset link slightly reduces access convenience, but the dataset remains identifiable; the net improvement is limited to presentation.
